subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding a simple weekly or monthly allowance and planning how to use it across spend, save, and give
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student divides a simulated allowance amount across spend/save/give categories using physical tokens
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an allowance amount to a reasonable three-way split
exercise.abstract: Student explains their own reasoning for how they divided a given allowance

assessment.mastery_threshold: division across all three categories is reasonable and adds up to the full amount
misconception_flags: allocates the full amount to only one category, ignoring the other two

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
